evidence.claim_boundary: SDK-native, manual formula-reference, external formula-shim, and native external-library evidence are categorized separately so formula and native runtime claims are not conflated.

external_native_status.note: Formula-shim or manual-reference rows are not native external-library workflow evidence; native external rows are reported only in native_external.

checks.detail: Random baseline rows are required for strategy comparisons.
checks.name: random_baseline_present

checks.detail: Quality gates need at least one strategy to compare against random.
checks.name: at_least_one_non_random_strategy

checks.detail: Every non-random dataset/seed/budget row must have a matching random baseline.
checks.name: random_baseline_complete

checks.detail: At least one strategy must simultaneously have non-negative final macro-F1 lift, non-negative AULC lift, meaningful-acquisition non-loss-rate >= 2/3, final-budget non-loss-rate >= 2/3, and at least one positive final macro-F1 or AULC lift versus random. Meaningful acquisition rows require selected_count >= 2 when selected_count is present.
checks.name: single_strategy_quality_candidate

checks.detail: At least one non-random strategy must have a computable non-negative final macro-F1 or AULC lift versus matched random.
checks.name: non_random_non_negative_quality_lift

checks.detail: At least one strategy-vs-random macro-F1 win-rate must be computable.
checks.name: win_rate_available

checks.detail: When selections.csv is available, non-random strategies must not all share the same selected order in every comparable dataset/seed/budget group, and no strategy pair may be identical across all comparable groups.
checks.name: non_random_strategy_differentiation

checks.detail: Runtime summary rows with finite mean runtime must be present.
checks.name: runtime_summary_present

checks.detail: When manifest.json exists, the report must expose its evidence category.
checks.name: manifest_evidence_category_present

checks.detail: SDK-native, manual formula-reference, external formula-shim, and native external strategy claims must be categorized without overlap.
checks.name: strategy_claim_categories_separated

checks.detail: Stage 11 standard real evidence requires at least three distinct seeds; real_smoke is smoke-only and not standard evidence.
checks.name: stage11_real_standard_seed_count

checks.detail: Stage 11 standard real metrics.csv rows must include finite calibration, coverage, and zero-recall metrics.
checks.name: stage11_real_standard_metrics_present

checks.detail: Stage 11 standard real full_train_reference.csv rows must include finite calibration metrics.
checks.name: stage11_real_standard_full_train_calibration_present
